definitions.explanation: A feeling that combines both deep respect and warm affection toward someone, typically a mentor, elder, or admired figure.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}を{敬愛|けいあい}している。
examples.english: I deeply respect and admire my teacher.

examples.japanese: {敬愛|けいあい}する{祖父|そふ}から{多|おお}くのことを{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned many things from my beloved and respected grandfather.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{学生|がくせい}たちから{敬愛|けいあい}されている{教授|きょうじゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is a professor who is both respected and loved by his students.

notes: Combines {敬|けい} (respect) and {愛|あい} (love/affection). Unlike {尊敬|そんけい} (respect) which focuses purely on admiration, {敬愛|けいあい} carries a warmer emotional component. Typically directed toward teachers, mentors, parents, and other admired elders. The pattern {敬愛|けいあい}する + noun is common as a modifier: {敬愛|けいあい}する{先輩|せんぱい} (a respected and beloved senior).
